newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai grain market to shorten trade for Deng.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai grain market to shorten trade for Deng.

text.p: Shanghai Cereals and Oils Exchange will shorten trading on Tuesday morning for the funeral of late Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping, an exchange announcement said on Monday.
Trading will start at 9 a.m. (0100 GMT) but will close at 9:50 a.m. (0150 GMT) instead of 11 a.m. (0300 GMT) usually, the announcement said.
Beijing has announced that the funeral will start at 10 a.m. (0200 GMT) on Tuesday.
The Shanghai Metal Exchange will cancel trading sessions between 9:45 a.m. and 10:55 (0145 GMT and 0255 GMT), an exchange statement said on Monday.
But a spokesman for the Shanghai stock exchange said that the exchange would trade normally on Tuesday.
